scope: CR-2 (owner-approved 2026-09-12): CoffeeReview blind-assessment parser v2. The v1 sentence shape ('... in aroma and cup') is the post-2012 house style; before 2012 the same reviews list descriptors in other shapes. This is a parser coverage defect, not a relaxation of data rules.

v2_design.v1_frozen: the v1 sentence is extracted first under its v1 locator (sentence=aroma-and-cup) so every v1 atom keeps its id; the v1 span is then masked before the v2 shapes run.

shapes.in-the-cup-prefix: 'In the cup silky mouthfeel, ..., distinct cocoa, orange and berry notes'
shapes.notes-of: 'notes of orange, lemon and flowers' (stops at 'in aroma/cup', 'that/which/as')
shapes.aroma-through-cup: 'X and Y run through aroma and cup'
shapes.bare-list: post-2012 reviews without the v1 sentence: a sentence of >= 4 short items, only when v1 missed

v2_design.item_filter_v2_only: items > 4 words, items carrying structure/setup/clause vocabulary (acidity, mouthfeel, finish, is/are/with/that, digits) are dropped; leading articles and hedges ('a hint of', 'notes of') stripped. v1 items untouched.
v2_design.measurability: each shape writes its own pattern id into source_locator, so its atoms can be counted, audited, or revoked separately.

measurement_v2_1.rejected_first_draft: v2.0 without the v1 mask and item filter: notes-of 5,736 atoms at 4.4 words/atom (42% > 4 words, re-captured v1 tails), bare-list 4,689 atoms at registry rate 0.26 (the 3-item adjective opener). Both fixed by design (mask, >= 4 items, item filter), not by dropping data.
measurement_v2_1.quality_reading: every retained shape maps to registry words at or above the v1 rate except in-the-cup-prefix (0.56 vs 0.61), with atom length matching v1; the added atoms are dominated by the 2004-2011 era the v1 shape could not see.
measurement_v2_1.registry_word_gauge: 90 EXISTING_CANONICAL_CONCEPT ids from SEMANTIC_CONCEPT_NODE plus 14 family words; a proxy, not a validation.

checkpoint.rule: CANDIDATE_77K is immutable, so the v2 delta becomes the next frozen checkpoint

83K.identity_guard: build_cleaned_83k refuses a v2 ledger that does not carry exactly the 27,004 v1 rows unchanged (compared in the segment id namespace)

next: CR-1b-ii: derive the owner review surface (gap register / cluster V2 enrichment) from the 83K consolidation.
